backfillRows.why: batch P02 unfurling-brocade#two-handed-die: AoN hybrid-study-8 "You can use the fabric as a bladed scarf. Unlike a normal bladed scarf, you have the option to wield the fabric in one hand instead of two. Its damage die is d4 if held in one hand." items/bladed-scarf is two-handed 1d6 slashing, so the default grip is a d6 Strike and the one-handed grip a d4. GrantedStrike has no hands field, so the two grips are two named rows (collectGrantedNaturals dedupes by name only). The die is written bare ('d6', 'd4' - the shape 266 of the 280 shipped grantedStrikes use): deriveUnarmedStrike prefixes the dice count, so the superseded row's '1d4' rendered on the Strikes tab as '11d4+1 S' (measured on a built level-1 magus). The default (bladed-scarf, two-handed d6) grip keeps the shipped name 'Qi-Infused Fabric' on purpose: a character saved before this row stores that name with die '1d4', and deriveBuildFromCharacter / buildCharacter drop a stored attack only when sameNaturalAttack matches it by NAME or by an identical die string - '1d4' never equals 'd4', so a renamed grip left the old row behind as a manual attack (measured by the P02 verifier: a pre-row save rebuilt to three fabric rows, one reading '11d4+1 S').

findings.note: Supersedes the existing grantedStrikes row (a single '1d4' entry). The default grip keeps the old row's name, traits and group with the printed two-handed d6 (so existing saves drop their stored copy by name); the one-hand d4 option is a second row. Dice are bare ('d6'/'d4') so neither renders as 11d4. Verifier change: the builder had renamed the default grip 'Qi-Infused Fabric (two hands)', which stranded the stored row on existing saves.

value.note: While in Arcane Cascade stance: if you critically succeed at an Athletics check to Disarm, you can spend a single action immediately afterward to flick your fabric, causing the disarmed object to fall to the ground in your space rather than in your opponent's.

While in Arcane Cascade stance, your fabric gains the grapple trait. If you succeed at an Athletics check to Grapple using your fabric, you can spend a single action immediately afterward to pull the creature 5 feet toward you.
While in Arcane Cascade stance: when you attempt to Trip a foe using your fabric, the target can be two sizes larger than you instead of one.

**Requirements** You have a hand free, and your Spellstrike is charged.

You weave distracting magic with one hand to enhance the efficacy of your Spellstrike. Make a Spellstrike and Feint against the target of your Strike. Execute your Feint immediately before making the Strike, but after choosing your target.

The Feint gains the arcane and visual traits, and it always has the basic effects of a Feint, rather than applying any adjustments or alternate effects from other feats or abilities.
